skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Rainforest, Me, Rainbow
skins.content: Brand Collaborative Series/Rainforest, Me, Rainbow. The waterproof, breathable fabric comes in handy for rainforest work. Lightweight, wear-resistant, and protects from the sun. Tail attachment optional.
skins.usage: Outfit worn by Franka for long trips.
skins.quote: Swing once, send five fowlbeasts scampering. Swing twice, make a blue fowl land on the fingertip. Swing three times, make the teacher's pet hysterical again.
